---
name: Dispute a data set row
about: Ask the maintainers to check, correct or annotate a row of the published data set
title: "Dispute: <package URL>"
labels: dispute
---

Please tell us which row you are disputing and why. The maintainers answer within fourteen days with the evidence behind the row and either keep it, correct it or annotate it; corrections appear as annotated rows in the next release and the history is kept. If you are the person behind a keyed-hash identifier and object to its publication, say so here or write to the address in SECURITY.md; a successful objection ends in redaction of the identifier with an annotation that keeps the row's history.
